The parameterized tests below all share the same column layout. Each row produced by the data-provider methods is an 8-tuple consumed positionally by the test method: [0] args - the command-line arguments to parse. [1] opt - the option to query directly (the "T" or "U" option). [2] optionGroup - the group containing both "T" and "U". [3] optDep - true if querying 'opt' should trigger the deprecation handler. [4] optExpected - the value/flag expected when querying 'opt' directly. [5] grpDep - true if querying 'optionGroup' should trigger the deprecation handler. [6] grpExpected - the value/flag expected when querying 'optionGroup'. [7] grpOpt - the option the group is expected to resolve/select. Only the "T" option is declared deprecated, so 'optDep'/'grpDep' are true exactly when the relevant query resolves to "T".
